comment: Documented safety thresholds. C++ defaults match these values. Reasons are not physical laws.
max_vehicle_speed_reason: Passenger-road demo envelope (~198 km/h). Rejects 194.4 m/s (~700 km/h) AI/GNSS spikes.
max_speed_change_reason: ~1.2 g longitudinal envelope for emergency accel/brake using actual dt.
variance_reason: Zero/NaN/tiny variance would over-trust a bad AI measurement; huge variance is still used but weakly.
map_search_radius_reason: HMM candidates farther than this are never considered; prevents city-scale snap.
